cadenas.en_por_celda: 03 · Seafood HACCP & Traceability Checklist: Shellfish Tags, Allergens & Critical Control Points
FDA Seafood List (market names)
ALLERGENS — Fish & Shellfish
Crustaceans
Molluscs

Receiving: fresh fish at 41 °F or below; frozen food received frozen solid (0 °F or below is the common target); shellstock per NSSP rules (on ice, or shipped at 45 °F air or 50 °F internal or below), then held at 41 °F (FDA Food Code 3-202.11)
Reject if above 41 °F

cadenas.es: Coccion: temperatura interna >=63°C en pescados y mariscos cocidos
cadenas.en_por_celda: Cooking: whole fish and shellfish to 145 °F for 15 s internal; comminuted fish 155 °F for 17 s; stuffed fish 165 °F (FDA Food Code 3-401.11)

cadenas.es: Anisakis: congelación previa −20 °C/24 h (o −35 °C/15 h) si se sirve crudo o marinado
cadenas.en_por_celda: Raw or undercooked fish (crudo, ceviche, tartare) — parasite destruction (FDA Food Code 3-402.11; some species are exempt, see 3-402.11(B)): frozen and stored at −4 °F or below for 7 days, or frozen at −31 °F or below until solid and stored at −31 °F or below for 15 h, or frozen at −31 °F or below until solid and stored at −4 °F or below for 24 h; keep the record 90 days (FDA Food Code 3-402.12) and the consumer advisory on the menu (FDA Food Code 3-603.11)
Required (FDA Food Code 3-402.11)
